title: Delivery Gate Restoration Record
description: Machine-readable record generated by dg separate. Enables dg restore to safely identify a transfer stash, verify the separation, and apply it to a target worktree. All fields required for safe restore; never drop stash before verifying against this record.

schema_version.description: Restoration record schema version. Must be '1.0'.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this restoration record (derived from operation_id + timestamp).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this record was created.

operation_id.description: Separation operation identifier (from separation plan or auto-generated).

stash_sha.description: SHA of the transfer stash object. Used for identity verification — never rely on positional stash@{N} alone.

stash_message.description: Message of the transfer stash. Used as secondary identity confirmation.

source_worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree where the stash was created.

destination_worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree where the stash was applied (or where restore should apply it).

destination_branch.description: Branch name in the destination worktree.

expected_head_at_separation.description: HEAD SHA of source worktree at separation time. Used to verify restoration target matches the original base.

exact_paths.description: Exact relative paths that were separated. Must be verified after restore.

expected_path_count.description: Expected number of paths. Must equal length of exact_paths.

pre_separation_hash_manifest.description: Absolute path to the SHA-256 hash manifest generated before separation. Used to verify restored content identity.

stash_dropped.description: Whether the transfer stash has been dropped. Set to true only after dg restore --verify confirms exact restoration. Never set before verification.

verified.description: Whether dg restore has confirmed exact path-count and hash equality. Never drop stash if false.
